meta.title: RecSys Atlas (global)
meta.rule: Universe: the deduplicated recommender corpus of the RecSys Steering Committee analysis (OpenAlex snapshot 2026-09-28, sc_impact_data.py; 82236 works 1990-2026) restricted to the works within the RecSys topics of the atlas (title embedding, mean cosine similarity to the 10 nearest atlas papers >= 0.5016, as in sc_authors_atlas.py), plus all 2467 ACM RecSys papers of the atlas at their atlas positions. Shown: every ACM RecSys atlas paper; every other relevant work with at least T = 3.7 citations per year since publication (citations / (2026 - year + 1), OpenAlex citations summed over merged versions); and, for 2023-2026, also the top 12% of each year's relevant works by citations per year (ties: higher relevance score first), so that fresh work without many citations yet is visible. T is the value on a 0.1 grid that brings the total closest to 12000.

legend.id: OpenAlex work id (W...) or, for an ACM RecSys atlas paper without an OpenAlex match, its atlas id
legend.t: title (completed with the subtitle where OpenAlex cuts it at the colon; atlas title for rs papers)
legend.v: canonical venue (meta.venues); "other" = a venue outside that list (then so = OpenAlex source name), "arXiv-only" = preprint only
legend.so: OpenAlex source name, only when v == "other"
legend.c: citations (OpenAlex cited_by_count summed over merged versions, snapshot 2026-09-28; atlas count for the few unmatched rs papers)
legend.i: indices into institutions[] (all affiliations of all authors)
legend.ind: 1 if any affiliation is industry (OpenAlex type company, or a known industry lab typed facility); absent = 0
legend.x: map x (atlas coordinates, bbox): atlas position for rs papers, jittered in-island position (meta.position) for the others
legend.st: subtopic index (subtopics[] / work/topics/subtopics-v0.json id), may be null
legend.u: link: DOI URL or OpenAlex URL (atlas link for rs papers)
legend.rs: 1 = ACM RecSys paper of the atlas (exact atlas position); absent = 0
legend.aid: atlas paper id (rs-...) for the paper explorer, only when rs == 1
legend.cy: citations per year (OpenAlex counts_by_year of this record, fetched 2026-10-01): the last element is 2026 (January-September), the first is the first year with a citation (not before 2012, where counts_by_year starts); absent when there is none or no counts (meta.momentum)
legend.cr: recent citations per year: (c2025 + c2026) / 1.75 (2026 counted through September)
legend.pk: peak year: the year with the most citations per year in counts_by_year (2026 annualised: / 0.75; ties: the later year)
legend.m: momentum class: "r" rising (cr >= 0.8 x peak rate, cr >= 5, pk >= 2024), "p" past peak (pk <= 2023 and cr < 0.5 x peak rate), "s" steady (everything else, including few citations); absent without an OpenAlex W id or counts (meta.momentum)
legend.institutions: {id: OpenAlex institution id, n: name, type: OpenAlex type, cc: country code, papers: selected papers carrying it, ind: 1 if industry}
legend.yearTotalsAll: all relevant works per year (the universe; use for shares)
legend.yearIndAll: relevant works with an industry affiliation per year
legend.yearAffAll: relevant works with any known affiliation per year
legend.regionYear: per region over all relevant works: n, aff (with known affiliation), ind (industry), indShare = ind/aff, years, indYears

position.rule: The method's placement (similarity-weighted mean of the (x, y2) of the K nearest atlas papers) usually lies between islands (median distance from the voted region's centre: 2.2 island radii), because the neighbours come from several regions. The in-island position uses the same neighbours and weights restricted to those in the voted region: a convex combination of atlas papers of that island, so it lies on the island, next to the RecSys papers the work is most similar to (and consistent with the subtopic vote, which also counts only neighbours in the voted region). The neighbours are recomputed with the same function (sc_authors_atlas.topk, same embeddings, same exclusion of atlas papers with the same title) and must reproduce the stored region and placement of every work.

stats.reproduced: region, placement and score of every work

jitter.rule: ACM RecSys atlas papers keep their exact position. Every other dot starts from its in-island position (pulled to ISLAND_FRAC x rad of its region in the rare case it lies further out). Its candidate offsets are its own position and TRIES deterministic offsets (from the sha1 of its id and the try number) uniformly distributed in a disk of radius JIT0 x sqrt(n), n = number of other shown dots within DENS_R of its position (capped at JIT_MAX and at JIT_MAX_FRAC x rad), so the room grows with the local density and isolated dots do not move; offsets that leave the island are discarded. Dots are placed in a fixed order (atlas papers, then the others by citations, then id), and each takes the smallest candidate offset that keeps it at least GAP from every dot placed before it, or else the candidate with the most room (best-candidate sampling). Influential papers therefore move least.

momentum.rule: recent = citations in 2025 and 2026 per year = (c2025 + c2026) / (1 + 0.75), 2026 counted through September; yearly rates use c2026 / 0.75 for 2026; peak year = the year with the highest yearly rate in the counts_by_year window (2012-2026; ties: the later year), peak = its rate; momentum = recent / max(1, peak). Class m: "r" rising = momentum >= 0.8, recent >= 5 citations/year and peak year >= 2024 (still at its peak); "p" past peak = peak year <= 2023 and momentum < 0.5; "s" steady = everything else (including papers with few citations). Only papers with an OpenAlex W id have the fields.
momentum.source: OpenAlex API /works?filter=openalex_id:... select=id,counts_by_year,cited_by_count, keyless, 50 ids per request (work/scripts/fetch_global_counts.py, cache work/global/cache-counts/)

sources: OpenAlex works snapshot 2026-09-28 (work/sc/openalex-snapshot.json.gz), keyless API, CC0
ACM RecSys atlas (booth/atlas-map.json, 2,467 papers 2007-2026) and subtopics (work/topics/subtopics-v0.json)
atlas relevance and placement: work/scripts/sc_authors_atlas.py (METHOD.md section 9); all-MiniLM-L6-v2 title embeddings
Crossref subtitles for titles cut at the colon (cached)
citations per year: OpenAlex API counts_by_year, fetched 2026-10-01 (work/scripts/fetch_global_counts.py; cache work/global/cache-counts/)

affiliation_pass.rule: OpenAlex maps raw affiliation strings to institutions; two failure modes matter for an industry filter:   1. companies that OpenAlex does not know at all (e.g. "Recombee, Prague") are lost, and   2. some strings are matched to the wrong company (e.g. "Gravity R&D" -> "Fluid Gravity Engineering (United Kingdom)"). This script fetches the raw affiliation strings of every shown paper (OpenAlex works API, 50 ids per request, cached in work/global/cache-raw/), then per authorship   - drops a company-type institution when its brand name (or a known alias) appears in none of that author's raw strings,   - adds companies named in the raw strings from a curated list of recommender-relevant firms OpenAlex does not map. Universities and other non-company institutions are left as OpenAlex gives them. Only the 12,010 shown papers change; corpus-wide statistics (yearIndAll, regionYear) stay as computed from OpenAlex.
